verdict.rationale: Jan runs local LLMs such as Llama, Gemma, Qwen and GPT-oss from HuggingFace. It is powered by llama.cpp, accepts GGUF imports and lets you search any Hugging Face model ID, which suggests broad coverage of text-LLM architectures. The evidence never addresses MoE, multi-modal or embedding models, nor 'hundreds' of architectures. Missing for 10: explicit multi-modal/vision model support, embedding model support, documented MoE support, an enumerated architecture count or support matrix, and independent corroboration.
